script_text: Taurus, Venus slams into retrograde in your 6th House, and love and money will collide. Newly direct Uranus sextiles Neptune from your 1st to your 12th, reshaping private boundaries. Wednesday’s Moon enters your 2nd, making income choices feel urgent rather than negotiable. Thursday is the turning point: Venus, your Earth-sign ruler, nears station in your 6th, pulling relationships and routines into review. Saturday, Venus stations retrograde at 10° Libra and a last-quarter Moon squares it, destabilizing love timing and cash flow. Sunday’s Moon conjunct Jupiter in your 3rd and opposite Uranus in your 1st, favoring a measured salary conversation. Sunday is your power day because the Moon-Jupiter conjunction supports clear pay terms. Saturday is your worst day because the Venus-Moon square makes romance and workplace feelings hard to read. Set one clear boundary and put all important cash numbers in writing. Follow for daily updates.
